publication.title: A new basal ornithopod (Dinosauria: Ornithischia) from the Early Cretaceous of Texas

locality.name: Proctor Lake locality (Camp Quarry and North Quarry collection)

age.basis: The paper assigns the Proctor Lake material to the Aptian Twin Mountains Formation and describes the locality low in the unit, with the formation base around 125 Ma or potentially older and the overlying Glen Rose base near 113 Ma.
age.notes: This is a broad contextual bracket, not a direct specimen date; the source notes uncertainty at the older boundary.

claims.summary: SMU 72834 is designated the holotype of Convolosaurus marri.

Published material for SMU 72834: skull, partial articulated skeleton, 9 cervical vertebrae, 15 dorsal vertebrae, 6 sacral vertebrae, 23 caudal vertebrae, scapulae, coracoids, humeri, left ulna, left radius, partial left manus, articulated pelvis, femora, tibiae, proximal left fibula.
